description: Real definition OAI.Problem335.ceilSqrt (DepthFive challenge) against the specification 'least k with n ≤ k²'. Checked as: ceilSqrt n is that least k.
preamble:
def ceilSqrt (n : Nat) : Nat := Nat.sqrt n + if (Nat.sqrt n) ^ 2 = n then 0 else 1
def ceilDiv (n t : Nat) : Nat := (n + t - 1) / t
reference: n ≤ (ceilSqrt n) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ j, j < ceilSqrt n → j ^ 2 < n
